western.heading: Discover a Name That Resonates with Your Zodiac Sign
western.p1: In Western astrology, every zodiac sign is traditionally associated with distinct qualities, energies and personality traits.
western.p2: Whether you're naming a newborn, starting a business or beginning something new, explore names and starting syllables traditionally associated with your zodiac sign.
western.p3: According to astrological beliefs, choosing a name aligned with these qualities is thought to create a symbolic harmony between the name, the individual's identity and the universal energies represented by the zodiac.

vedic.heading: Discover a Name That Resonates with Your Birth Star
vedic.p1: In Vedic astrology, the moment of birth determines a child's Nakshatra (birth star) and Pada (quarter). Each of the 27 Nakshatras is traditionally associated with specific sounds and syllables believed to carry distinct cosmic vibrations.
vedic.p2: For generations, families have used these auspicious syllables when naming newborns, believing that a name beginning with the recommended sound creates harmony with the cosmic energies associated with the child's birth star.
vedic.p3: This traditional practice can also inspire the naming of businesses, ventures and new beginnings, with the belief that a thoughtfully chosen name symbolises harmony, positivity and auspicious beginnings.
